content.short: Arkham's own exchange for spot and perpetuals, with its wallet labels and entity tracking shown right next to the order book.
content.description: Arkham built its name on onchain intelligence, labelling wallets and tracking the funds of exchanges, funds and well-known traders. The exchange brings that data into the trading screen, so a user can check who is moving size while placing an order. It offers spot and perpetual markets on major assets with zero maker fees. It is a separate product from Arkham's analytics platform, which already has its own listing. Its labels and profiles span over 700,000 entities, and Tim Draper and Joe Lonsdale are among the people who have invested.
content.meta: Spot and perps exchange with Arkham's onchain entity tracking built into the trading view. Explore Arkham Exchange on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
